summary:
All 14 acceptance criteria hold at 0ecee0a. This attempt is scoped STALE: the tree moved under my attempt-2 pass (bd556e5), but the move changed no code. `git diff --stat bd556e5 0ecee0a` touches only four .taad/slices/SL-033 records. The same diff limited to src, tests, eng, .taad/fitness.yaml, Directory.Build.props, global.json and FsAnalyser.slnx is empty, and so is the working tree against HEAD. The code is byte-for-byte what I validated in attempt 2.

I still re-ran everything I could reach at this head instead of carrying attempt 2's numbers forward:
- Core tests: 120/120.
- Fitness (rebuilt): all 20 rules hold.
- rules-parity: AGREE.
- WindowCases -Case All: all 15 cases passed in 161 s.
  - C-006: acted at 516 ms, stopped after 550 of 30,150 folders, with a 'Stopped:' title.
  - C-012: acted at 668 ms, exit 70 (0x46).
  - O-016: acted at 689 ms, exit 70.
- WindowMutants -Mutant All: all 8 mutants passed in 283 s. Each failed its case for exactly the planted reason:
  - StopDisabled and StopCollapsed: only 'the hook acted'.
  - NoCrashHandler: 0xE0434352.
  - NoExitRule: 0.
  - CancelThrows: 'rethrown', 70, no report.
  - HookFailsAfterActing: only the after-acting check.
  - HookCompileError: CS1029, and no case ran.
  - HookLocked: MSB3027/MSB3021, and no case ran.
- I re-ran my attempt-2 probe scripts:
  - O-002: C-006's main step, taken verbatim from WindowCases.ps1, on a small tree and on an empty tree, 10/10. Every run failed only on 'the hook acted', never on an ending.
  - Criteria 13 and 14: modes 'bogus' and 'STOP' were refused and the app ran to Completed. A relative dll path and one containing ';' made the host exit 0xE0434352 with an empty log. CheckActed failed in all four.

Afterwards no FsAnalyser.App processes, temp items or hook variables were left, and git status matched the start.

Loop check: build-slice ran three times. The first retry fixed O-015. The second was the engine re-sending it for O-002, which landed after its pass, and it rightly changed no code. validate's attempt 2 was taken back as STALE, not WRONG. Each lap has a distinct cause, so this is not a loop.

Contact is `code`: every run used trees generated under %TEMP% on this one Windows 11 PC.

Exit 0 in 283 s, PASSED all 8.
- StopDisabled: the log showed 'waiting ... enabled=False visible=True', and the single FAIL was 'the hook acted'.

checks.what: O-002 / criterion 2 probe: C-006's committed main step (taken verbatim from WindowCases.ps1 by AST) on trees where the scan ends before the hook can act

On the empty tree all 5 logs end with 'refused mode=stop reason=the app shut down first'. On the small tree, 3 logs end that way and 2 stop at 'waiting', because the process exited before the hook could log. The reported failure is the same. envLeft 0; 9 s.

- bogus: 'loaded mode=bogus | refused mode=bogus reason=unknown mode', exit 0, report Completed, CheckActed=FAIL.
- STOP: the same result (the match is case-sensitive).

checks.evidence: Not repeated at this head: the code is byte-identical to bd556e5, where it ran 45/45 (stop 15/15 Cancelled at 550-750 folders; close and throw each 15/15 exit 70 with no report). One run of each mode passed here in -Case All, and the mutants re-ran the stop mode 8 times.

checks.what: Update-Hook against a REAL leftover FsAnalyser.App.exe holding the dll
checks.evidence: Not repeated. Attempt 1 measured it at 105f1a4 (MSB3027 'locked by FsAnalyser.App', exit 1, dll unchanged), and Update-Hook has not changed since. This run's HookLocked mutant passed, using a PowerShell FileStream as a stand-in for the lock.

checks.what: A real input-driven press (mouse or UIA) on a CancelButton whose handler throws
checks.evidence: The stack rules out UIA, FlaUI and WinAppDriver, and I may not drive another program's windows. The claim that the hook's re-raise lands where a real click would is reasoning about WPF, not a measurement.

criteria.criterion: 1. stop the scan (C-006) when Stop is pressable and the scan is running on the 30,150-folder New-LargeTree
criteria.how: C-006 in -Case All at 0ecee0a passed: acted at 516 ms with enabled=True visible=True, exit 0, root as passed, the 'Stopped:' title, stopped after 550 of 30,150 folders.

criteria.criterion: 2. stop the scan (C-006) when the scan finishes before the hook acts (tree too small, or a warm cache)
criteria.how: I fed that exact case: C-006's verbatim main step on an empty and on a small tree, 10/10. Every run failed only on 'the hook acted', never on an ending mismatch. The committed StopDisabled mutant, where the scan ends before the hook can act, likewise failed only on 'the hook acted'. Test-C006 still builds New-LargeTree, and on this run the scan was stopped at 550 of 30,150 folders.

criteria.criterion: 3. stop the scan (C-006) when CancelButton is IsEnabled=false during the scan (scratch mutant)
criteria.how: WindowMutants StopDisabled: the hook logged 'waiting found=True enabled=False visible=True' and never acted. C-006 failed once, on 'the hook acted'.

criteria.criterion: 4. stop the scan (C-006) when CancelButton is Visibility=Collapsed during the scan (scratch mutant)
criteria.how: WindowMutants StopCollapsed: the button was never visible and the hook never acted. C-006 failed once, on 'the hook acted'.

criteria.criterion: 5. stop the scan (C-006) when CancelButton is pressable before StartScan begins (XAML default is enabled)
criteria.how: In C-006's no-scan step (-Case All) the hook saw enabled=True visible=False, did not press, and refused once its 20 s were up.

criteria.criterion: 6. exit-70 path (C-012): unhandled dispatcher exception mid-scan, handler present, stale report planted
criteria.how: C-012 passed: 'acted mode=throw' at 668 ms, then exit 70 (0x00000046) with the planted stale report gone.

criteria.criterion: 7. exit-70 path (C-012) with the DispatcherUnhandledException handler removed (scratch mutant)
criteria.how: WindowMutants NoCrashHandler: C-012 failed once, 'exit code is the app's 70 (actual -532462766 (0xE0434352))'.

criteria.criterion: 8. closed before the first ending (O-016): window closed while Stop is pressable, report mode, stale report planted
criteria.how: O-016 passed: 'acted mode=close' at 689 ms, then exit 70 (0x00000046) with the stale report gone.

criteria.criterion: 9. closed before the first ending (O-016) with the Exit handler's exit-0-without-a-file to 70 rule removed (scratch mutant)
10. hooked run cleanup when a case throws or fails after the three variables are set
criteria.how: C-006's cleanup step passed in -Case All. After the whole suite, all 8 mutants and 14 probe runs, no hook variable was left set in this session, and every probe reported envLeft 0.

criteria.criterion: 11. load the hook: a non-App .NET host inherits the variables (pwsh 7 with FSA_HOOK_MODE=close)
criteria.how: -Case All: the control (a missing dll) made pwsh exit 0xE0434352, so pwsh does run startup hooks. Under the real hook in close mode pwsh exited 0.

criteria.criterion: 12. build the hook: compile error, or dll locked by a leftover FsAnalyser.App.exe
criteria.how: HookCompileError (CS1029) and HookLocked (MSB3027/3021) each stopped the run in Update-Hook with exit 1: no case ran, and the earlier dll was still there. The lock by a real leftover FsAnalyser.App was measured in attempt 1; this run used a FileStream stand-in, and Update-Hook has not changed since.

criteria.criterion: 13. select a mode: FSA_HOOK_MODE is an unknown string
criteria.how: 'bogus' and 'STOP' each logged 'refused ... unknown mode', the app ran to Completed with exit 0, and CheckActed failed.

criteria.criterion: 14. locate the hook dll: the path is relative, or contains ';'
criteria.how: Both made the host exit 0xE0434352 with an empty log, and CheckActed failed, so the case cannot pass silently. The committed HookDll path is absolute, and the repo path has no ';'.

obligations.evidence: Re-measured at 0ecee0a. StopDisabled (committed): the hook log shows the scan ending before the hook could act, and C-006's single FAIL was 'the hook acted', with no ending mismatch. My verbatim C-006 main step on an empty and a small tree gave 10/10 runs failing only on 'the hook acted'. The tree stays large: C-006 stopped the scan at 550 of 30,150 folders.
At 0ecee0a, NoCrashHandler made throw mode exit 0xE0434352 and NoExitRule made close mode exit 0, so neither 70 comes from the hook.
At 0ecee0a, StopDisabled and StopCollapsed each made C-006 fail on 'the hook acted', and the no-scan step refused on an enabled but invisible CancelButton.

At 0ecee0a, CancelThrows logged 'rethrown mode=stop ...', and C-006 failed only on 'exit code' (actual 70) and 'a report was written'. HookFailsAfterActing failed only on 'the hook did not fail after it acted'.

not_reached: A real input-driven press (mouse or UIA) on a CancelButton whose handler throws. I measured in attempt 2 that the hook's re-raise lands as an unhandled dispatcher exception. That a real click behaves the same is reasoning about WPF, not a measurement.

A close-path crash regression. O-016 cannot tell the Exit rule's 70 from the crash handler's 70. NoExitRule shows that on this tree the 70 comes from the Exit rule, but a future OnClosing fault would still pass O-016, and no mutant covers it.
A machine where Windows Error Reporting shows a crash dialog. With the crash handler removed there, C-012 would likely show TIMEOUT rather than 0xE0434352.
Windows 10. Everything ran on Windows 11 26200 only.
Other .NET hosts inheriting the hook variables (dotnet.exe, MSBuild nodes). Only pwsh 7 was checked.

Much faster or slower disks and CPUs. Here the hook acted at 516-749 ms and stopped the scan at about 550 of 30,150 folders. On a much faster machine the scan could finish first. O-002's handling means that would fail as 'hook never acted', not pass silently.
Any real user data or drive. Every run used generated trees under %TEMP%, which is why contact is `code`, not `real`.
